verdict.rationale: Devin exposes some org-level access controls — e.g. an 'Enable desktop mode' toggle for Computer Use and a CLI --sandbox flag that enforces OS-level deny rules and can restrict network traffic — showing admins can gate specific capabilities. However there is no documented centralized admin console for granularly allow/deny-listing which external integrations (Slack, Jira, Linear, MCP servers, CI/CD tools) an agent session may use. Missing for 10: a unified integration/tool permissions dashboard, per-integration enable/disable controls, and audit evidence of an engineering-lead restricting specific external tool access in practice.
